item.title: Self-Hosted Phylogenetic Tree Inference: IQ-TREE 2 vs RAxML-NG vs BEAST 2 vs MrBayes
item.description: Phylogenetic trees — the branching diagrams depicting evolutionary relationships among species, genes, or populations — are the lingua franca of evolutionary biology. From tracking viral outbreaks to resolving deep branches of the tree of life, phylogenetics underpins our understanding of how life diversified over 4 billion years.
